INSERT INTO actionnow.monitor_attempt_logs (
  monitor_setting_id, owner_email, owner_phone_num, monitor_name,
  matched_slot_at, window_start, window_end,
  relevance_score, score_threshold, passes_threshold,
  score_reason, score_insights, message_count,
  keywords_snapshot, content_types_snapshot, corpus_preview,
  outcome, model_provider, model_name
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4,
  NULLIF($5, '')::timestamptz, $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz,
  $8::integer, $9::integer, $10::boolean,
  NULLIF($11, ''), $12::jsonb, $13::integer,
  $14::text[], $15::text[], NULLIF($16, ''),
  $17, 'openrouter', $18
)
RETURNING id, outcome, relevance_score, passes_threshold, monitor_setting_id;

  $json.model_name ?? 'google/gemini-2.5-flash-preview'
] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  wm.message_id,
  wm.chat_jid,
  wm.is_group,
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) AS message_at,
  wm.message_body,
  wm.content_type,
  wm.sender_phone,
  wm.has_media,
  COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT wmi.content, ' | '), '') AS media_text,
  'media_interpretation' AS source_kind
FROM actionnow.whatsapp_media_interpretations wmi
INNER JOIN actionnow.whatsapp_messages wm
  ON wm.message_id = wmi.message_id
WHERE wmi.owner_email = $1
  AND wmi.status = 'done'
  AND wmi.updated_date >= $2::timestamptz
  AND wmi.updated_date <= $3::timestamptz
  AND wm.from_me = false
  AND (
    (cardinality($4::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($4::text[]))
    OR (cardinality($5::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($5::text[]))
  )
GROUP BY wm.id, wm.message_id, wm.chat_jid, wm.is_group, wm.whatsapp_timestamp,
         wm.received_at, wm.created_date, wm.message_body, wm.content_type,
         wm.sender_phone, wm.has_media
ORDER BY message_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  wm.message_id,
  wm.chat_jid,
  wm.is_group,
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) AS message_at,
  wm.message_body,
  wm.content_type,
  wm.sender_phone,
  wm.has_media,
  '' AS media_text,
  'text_message' AS source_kind
FROM actionnow.whatsapp_messages wm
WHERE wm.owner_email = $1
  AND COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) >= $2::timestamptz
  AND COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) <= $3::timestamptz
  AND wm.from_me = false
  AND (wm.has_media = false OR wm.content_type = 'text')
  AND (
    (cardinality($4::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($4::text[]))
    OR (cardinality($5::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($5::text[]))
  )
ORDER BY message_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
